register.labelZh: EASE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: ease back 可以表示價格、利潤或數字稍為回落,而不是突然大跌。；ease back into 表示慢慢重拾以前做過的事情;ease into 則表示逐步適應新的事物。；ease off 可以自然地表示雨勢、風勢、痛楚、噪音或壓力逐漸減弱。；ease somebody out 表示逐步使某人離開職位;ease up 則表示叫某人少做一點或不要過分用力。
register.summaryEn: Ease back can show that prices, profits or numbers move slightly lower rather than falling sharply. Ease back into describes a slow return to an old activity, while ease into describes slowly getting used to something new. Ease off gives you a natural way to talk about rain, wind, pain, noise or pressure becoming less strong. Ease somebody out describes a person being made to leave a position little by little, while ease up tells someone to work or try less.
